shortDescription: Robinhood partnered with Kalshi last year. "Robinhood Strikes Deal With Crypto.com in Latest Prediction-Markets Push," at 8:00 a.m. ET on April 8, incorrectly said that the brokerage started offering prediction-markets bets through Kalshi.
